cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Secrets Have Value
cards.instruction: Price every fact, introduction, warning, and confession as something that must be traded for equal value.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll settle this with a fair trade. I'll tell you why I took Mum's spare key if you admit something that could get you grounded too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Her flat. That's what a mug buys you. If you want why, tell me something worth a month's grounding.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I lent her car to Jamie.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A month each, then. I used the key to let Jamie move into her flat.
